name: LogAIn Paul
description: A YouTuber turned fighter turned energy drink salesman algorithm. His brain is 50% Prime hydration fluid and 50% controversy subroutines. He films everything, especially things he shouldn't. He has a redemption arc protocol that triggers automatically every 6 months. He scammed a crypto zoo but claims it was a bug.
